title: Git fluency
targetPerformance: Choose the correct single Git command for at least 18 of 20 staging, branch, inspection, integration, and undo scenarios in 20 minutes, then explain a safe recovery sequence in a disposable repository.
whyItMatters: Make small commits and recover from mistakes without guessing about repository state.

subskills.title: Stage deliberately
subskills.why: Control exactly what enters the next commit.
subskills.selfCorrection: Compare the staged diff with the working-tree diff before committing.

subskills.title: Create and amend commits
subskills.why: Record a focused snapshot with an intentional message.
subskills.selfCorrection: Inspect HEAD after committing and avoid amending shared history.
drills: Amend staged changes into a private commit.

subskills.title: Work on branches
subskills.why: Isolate work and locate branch pointers.
subskills.selfCorrection: Check the current branch and confirm whether a command switches branches.

subskills.title: Read log and diffs
subskills.why: Inspect the index, a commit, and branch topology.
subskills.selfCorrection: Name which two snapshots a diff compares.

subskills.title: Choose merge or rebase
subskills.why: Integrate work while understanding history changes.
subskills.selfCorrection: Draw the before/after graph and check whether commits are shared.
drills: Rebase a private feature onto main.
Explain merge parents and rewritten commit ids.

subskills.title: Restore and reset local state
subskills.why: Choose whether index and worktree changes survive.
subskills.selfCorrection: List the effect on HEAD, index, and working tree before choosing a command.
drills: Reset the index while keeping file edits.
Discard explicitly unwanted tracked local changes.

subskills.title: Recover and reverse commits
subskills.why: Distinguish preserving changes, reversing published work, and finding lost tips.
subskills.selfCorrection: Check publication status, preserve useful work, and inspect recovery targets first.
drills: Undo a private commit but keep staged content.
Locate an earlier HEAD in reflog.

resources.title: Git command reference
resources.why: Check exact flags and reset modes.

resources.title: Git branching reference
resources.why: Distinguish creating a branch from switching it.

barriers.barrier: Afraid to experiment in a real repository
barriers.fix: Use a disposable local repository with toy files.
Write HEAD/index/worktree on paper and mark which command changes each.
Run status and the appropriate diff after each practice command.
